thesis: The page is a section sawn through one Duluth house, roof peak to rim joist, and the warm air climbing it is stitched shut level by level, top down, as you read.

signature.name: Heat Riser + Seal Stitch
signature.summary: An ember riser line with upward chevrons climbs a 64px margin column; at each house level (L1 Roof deck to L6 Crawl floor, L0 Footing in the footer) it meets a leak notch that gets stitched shut with ice-blue cross-stitches when the level enters view, and the riser below turns still and ice. Hero: a 4-cell mosaic, the night photo huge under a gable cell plus 3 drawn level-cut tiles, the riser threading all four and leaking out of the ridge; story: pinned SVG house where 5 leaks are stitched one per step; service cards and reviews hang on their level with stitched notches; price rows and the 4-step form count stitches; footer: riser reaches the frost line fully sealed.

palette.family: Lake Superior Ink + Rime + Leak Amber + Stitch Ice

layoutMoves: 64px left margin column carrying the riser and level tags through every section
sections ordered top of house down (L1 roof to L0 footing) with level tags instead of section numbers
hero mosaic: the one night photo huge inside a gable-topped cell plus 3 drawn level-cut tiles (roof deck, attic, rim joist), each with a leak notch, h1 on the plain deep band
pinned SVG house cut-away story with fixed copy slot
snowbank paper bands between night bands with a drawn even-snow roofline as the full-bleed break

motion.intro: h1 line-mask rise 700ms/70ms stagger, mosaic cells wipe in top-down 600ms with 60ms stagger, riser draws from the peak 900ms, ember chevrons drift out of the ridge; skippable, under 1.1s
stories: stitch: pinned house section, 5 steps, each step stitches one leak and turns its arrow ice, last step draws an even snow roofline
draw: margin riser scrubs down the page and each level notch stitches at 60% viewport
motion.hover: stitch: 3 ice cross-stitches draw across the element's notch, 200ms, 60ms stagger
